cards.name: Countdown
cards.description: The days left until a date you choose.
cards.about: A heading and the number of days to go until a date: a holiday, a birthday, a trip. Fill in the title and the date (YYYY-MM-DD) on the phone page; the number changes by itself each day. Before the date it counts down, after it the card says how long ago it was.

cards.name: Quote
cards.description: A line you like, with who said it.
cards.about: A short quote in italics with the name of who said it, in three sizes. Type the text and the name on the phone page. A quiet card for a place beside the clock.

cards.name: Year progress
cards.description: How much of the year has gone.
cards.about: The year, the percentage that has passed and the days that are left. Nothing to set up: it updates by itself, and is a nice small card above the dock.
